name: WittyTuner
summary: Live TV and recording: network tuners, IPTV playlists, capture cards and guide data. Encrypted channels are refused.
needs: FFmpeg, which comes with the server
A tuner or an IPTV playlist
updates: Network tuners, IPTV over HTTP and external backends: finding them, reading their channels, scanning, and opening a stream.
stays: Custom commands, capture cards, Linux DVB, SAT>IP and IPTV over RTSP, RTP, UDP, RTMP or SRT, which need other programs or this machine's devices, and a helper may use neither. Refusing encrypted channels also stays: the server watches every stream itself and opens HLS and DASH itself, whatever a version says. Recording and the guide stay too.
